title: Client Handover Routine
summary: How to pass a client to the next team member without breaking the experience.
relevance: A smooth client handover demonstrates Zura Spa's commitment to professionalism and care. It:

list: Reflects orderliness and a well-coordinated team
Shows respect and attentiveness to the client's comfort
Ensures the client feels welcomed and at ease throughout their experience
Provides the client with clarity on who will be attending to them
Creates a seamless transition that enhances the overall spa experience

procedure.title: Escort the client
procedure.body: The reception therapist or client manager escorts the client to their assigned massage room, which has already been prepared and set up.

procedure.title: Therapists ready to receive
procedure.body: The assigned therapist(s) should be present in the room and ready to receive the client upon entry.

procedure.title: Introduce and hand over
procedure.body: The reception therapist or client manager formally introduces the client to the assigned therapist(s) and hands over any client belongings they assisted with (e.g., phone, bag, etc.).

procedure.title: Use the handover script
examples: Alright [Sir/Ma], this is [Therapist A] and [Therapist B]. They will be handling your session today. Please enjoy your session, and don't hesitate to call my attention if there is anything you'd like looked into.

procedure.title: Excuse yourself
procedure.body: Quietly excuse yourself and leave the room.
